entries.title: Psalms 2:1
segments: ¶Why are the nations in tumultuous agitation, and [why] do the peoples meditate a vain thing?

entries.title: Psalms 2:2
segments: The kings of the earth set themselves, and the princes plot together, against Jehovah and against his anointed:

entries.title: Psalms 2:3
segments: Let us break their bonds asunder, and cast away their cords from us!

entries.title: Psalms 2:4
segments: He that dwelleth in the heavens shall laugh, the Lord shall have them in derision.

entries.title: Psalms 2:5
segments: Then will he speak to them in his anger, and in his fierce displeasure will he terrify them:

entries.title: Psalms 2:6
segments: And *I* have anointed my king upon Zion, the hill of my holiness.

entries.title: Psalms 2:7
segments: ¶I will declare the decree: Jehovah hath said unto me, Thou art my Son; *I* this day have begotten thee.

entries.title: Psalms 2:8
segments: Ask of me, and I will give thee nations for an inheritance, and for thy possession the ends of the earth:

entries.title: Psalms 2:9
segments: Thou shalt break them with a sceptre of iron, as a potter's vessel thou shalt dash them in pieces.

entries.title: Psalms 2:10
segments: ¶And now, O kings, be ye wise, be admonished, ye judges of the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 2:11
segments: Serve Jehovah with fear, and rejoice with trembling.

entries.title: Psalms 2:12
segments: Kiss the Son, lest he be angry, and ye perish in the way, though his anger burn but a little. Blessed are all who have their trust in him.
